import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 14, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5.2, 4.6)) ax = fig.add_axes([0.04, 0.04, 0.92, 0.92]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-0.38, 3.22) ax.set_ylim(2.83, -0.38) ax.axis("off")
ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786" blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F"
# Schematic drawing coordinates only: no measured lengths or angles are implied. O = np.array([0.0, 0.0]) p1 = np.array([0.84, 1.30]) p2 = np.array([2.04, 2.28])
def arrow(start, end, color=ink, linewidth=1.2, scale=12): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=scale, linewidth=linewidth, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=2, ) ax.add_patch(patch) return patch
# Cartesian frame; positive y points downward. arrow((-0.20, 0.0), (2.80, 0.0)) arrow((0.0, -0.20), (0.0, 0.82)) ax.text(2.91, 0.0, r"$x$", ha="center", va="center") ax.text(-0.13, 0.76, r"$y$", ha="right", va="center") ax.text(-0.10, -0.13, r"$O\,(0,0)$", ha="right", va="bottom")
# Local downward vertical references for the two generalized coordinates. ax.plot( [0.0, 0.0], [0.85, 1.63], color=slate, linewidth=1.15, linestyle=(0, (4, 4)), zorder=1, ) ax.plot( [p1[0], p1[0]], [p1[1], 2.43], color=slate, linewidth=1.15, linestyle=(0, (4, 4)), zorder=1, )
# Ideal massless rods. ax.plot([O[0], p1[0]], [O[1], p1[1]], color=blue, linewidth=2.3, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=3) ax.plot([p1[0], p2[0]], [p1[1], p2[1]], color=teal, linewidth=2.3, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=3)
def angle_mark(center, vector, radius, label, label_radius): # Angles are independently measured from the downward vertical. theta = np.arctan2(vector[0], vector[1]) t = np.linspace(0.0, theta, 100) ax.plot( center[0] + radius * np.sin(t), center[1] + radius * np.cos(t), color=slate, linewidth=1.25, zorder=4, ) mid = theta / 2.0 ax.text( center[0] + label_radius * np.sin(mid), center[1] + label_radius * np.cos(mid), label, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14, )
angle_mark(O, p1 - O, 0.43, r"$\theta_1$", 0.66) angle_mark(p1, p2 - p1, 0.43, r"$\theta_2$", 0.66)
# Rod lengths, offset perpendicular to each rod. ax.text(0.61, 0.55, r"$l_1$", color=blue, ha="center", va="center") ax.text(1.55, 1.64, r"$l_2$", color=teal, ha="center", va="center")
ax.add_patch(Circle(O, 0.034, facecolor=ink, edgecolor=ink, zorder=6)) ax.add_patch(Circle(p1, 0.085, facecolor=blue, edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.0, zorder=6)) ax.add_patch(Circle(p2, 0.085, facecolor=teal, edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.0, zorder=6))
ax.text(p1[0] + 0.17, p1[1] - 0.09, r"$m_1$", ha="left", va="center") ax.text(p1[0] + 0.17, p1[1] + 0.16, r"$(x_1,y_1)$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=12) ax.text(p2[0] + 0.16, p2[1] - 0.09, r"$m_2$", ha="left", va="center") ax.text(p2[0] + 0.16, p2[1] + 0.17, r"$(x_2,y_2)$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=12)
# Uniform gravity, explicitly downward in the chosen Cartesian frame. arrow((2.76, 0.78), (2.76, 1.47), color=ink, linewidth=1.7, scale=14) ax.text(2.90, 1.10, r"$\mathbf{g}$", ha="left", va="center")
